failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The coordinator query is 'What is the release date of the movie "Tunisian Victory"? Which Ken Burns documentary featured journalist Charles McDowell, Jr. providing character voice work, and when was it released?' This is a compound multi-part query bundling three distinct targets: (1) release date of Tunisian Victory, (2) which Ken Burns documentary had McDowell's voice work, and (3) that documentary's release date.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: The solver summary explicitly identifies the missing entity: 'The release date of "Tunisian Victory" is NOT provided in the passages' and 'No information about "Tunisian Victory" exists in the provided passages. The specific release date of "Tunisian Victory" is required.' The coordinator query then targets this entity: 'What is the release date of the movie "Tunisian Victory"?' However, across all three hops (7 documents in hop 1, 10 documents in hop 3), no passage about Tunisian Victory ever appears—this is a retriever coverage gap.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1, the solver devotes reasoning to passages about Charles Wilkinson (a Canadian director unrelated to the claim), Moguls and Movie Stars (a 2010 TCM documentary irrelevant to the claim), Charles S. McDowell (Alabama Lieutenant Governor, different person), The West (1996 film that doesn't involve McDowell character voice work), and Burning Heads (a punk rock band). These are clearly irrelevant to verifying the Tunisian Victory claim.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Only one query is shown in the trace (hop 2 query generation is visible, but hop 2 retrieval event is not shown in the trace). The trace shows 'RETRIEVAL EVENT — hop 1 of 3 executed' and then jumps to 'RETRIEVAL EVENT — hop 3 of 3 executed' with the same set of irrelevant documents largely repeated (Charles McDowell passage appears 3 times, The Congress passage appears 3 times, Moguls and Movie Stars appears twice). The query does not advance the search—hop 3 returns substantially the same documents as hop 1 plus some additional irrelevant ones (Ken Griffey Jr. video games, Kate Winslet song, metal albums).

failure_modes.name: Retrieval_Loop_Terminated_Early
failure_modes.evidence: The trace shows 'RETRIEVAL EVENT — hop 1 of 3 executed' followed by query generation for hop 2, but no 'RETRIEVAL EVENT — hop 2 of 3 executed' message appears. The trace jumps directly to 'RETRIEVAL EVENT — hop 3 of 3 executed.' Only two retrieval events are explicitly present in the trace, not the required three.
